description: This Java class 'CommandAndEventJsonExamplesProducer' generates sample JSON files for commands and responses related to policies, specifically for testing purposes within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It creates directories, constructs specific policy objects, and serializes them into JSON files.

classes.name: CommandAndEventJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that produces sample JSON files representing command and response objects for policy-related testing, primarily for use within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for generating JSON files based on a target folder provided as an argument.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates the subdirectory structure and initiates JSON file production.

methods.name: produceSudoCommands
methods.description: Generates specific policy command and response JSON files related to 'sudo' policies.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object into a JSON string and writes it to the specified file path.
